parsed.rationale: Sinus rhythm with a narrow QRS and very high precordial voltage (deep S in V1–V2 plus tall R in V4–V6, summing well over 35 mm), and no significant ST elevation or reciprocal changes in any contiguous leads, so this does not meet STEMI criteria. This differs from the team's impression of acute STEMI.
